summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with parametrized valid and invalid cases plus None/string and graph-unchanged checks. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (43 passed) under the prepared interpreter. Deviations: I added an explicit None guard, since Graph.value(None, ...) would act as a wildcard. Not verified: mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in the venv, so type-check and formatting were checked by reading only; line lengths were checked with awk (none over 88). Nothing committed.
